dream: I stood on the tired stack, my toes numb. The turnip slid beneath me, cold and round, while the lean bent like a tired spine. Above, the air felt thin, a ghost of paper pressing down. I bit into the rough scrap to catch the edge. Then the wedge gave way. I fell into the warm hum, landing on a flat stone that wasn't there, the card vibrating beneath my heavy feet.
